Please arrive 15 minutes before the start time of the program. Your registration fee covers rental of all equipment plus instruction. The Chicago Park District's RiverLab program is a series of educational events and activities dedicated to reconnecting residents of Chicago with their river. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.

title: The Heart of the Story at Douglass
description: The Heart of the Story is Cerqua Rivera Dance Theatre’s concert dance program featuring members of their professional Dance Ensemble and Jazz Orchestra. Generally 45-60 minutes, events include performance, company members providing context and inviting feedback, and interactive activities. Cerqua Rivera uses dance as a medium to engage audiences in and celebrate the complexity of the human experience. Heart of the Story shares a thoughtful exploration of culture, race, and ethnicity through the company’s signature welcoming spirit and collaborative energy. Their choreography highlights the dualities found within each person–confidence and doubt, strength and vulnerability, grace and intensity.  https://www.cerquarivera.org/ Special Guest Performance: The Douglass Park Performing Company (DPPC) presenting, "He Turned It", with twelve passionate members, is ready to take the stage and make a statement. Through movement, emotion, and artistry, they will express what it means to stand up for what’s right and push for a better society. Choreography by Elaine McLaurin

description: Get ready to look up! In The Pieces, six performers build giant, wobbly towers using ladders—climbing, balancing, and daring each other to go higher. What starts as a tricky challenge quickly turns into an exciting adventure full of teamwork, big risks, and surprising saves. Will the structures stay up… or come crashing down? With thrilling acrobatics, playful energy, and larger-than-life shapes, this high-flying circus show is perfect for all ages. No words needed—just action, suspense, and plenty of “whoa!” moments. Come watch as the performers discover how working together can turn something unstable into something amazing. www.aloftcircusarts.com
